title: Salmon, Olive and Oregano Linguine
changes_from_base: Grilled salmon flaked through fresh linguine with soft onions, olives and oregano, no tomato sauce.
summary: Fresh linguine tossed with flaked grilled salmon, softened onion, briny olives and fresh oregano: a quick supper for two.

ingredients.item: pitted green or black olives in brine, chopped
fine salt for 2 litres of pasta water (0.8%)
ingredients.note: about 2.75 tsp; most of it goes down the drain

steps.title: Grill the salmon
steps.text: Heat the grill to high and cook the salmon on the foil-lined tray 6-8 cm from the heat for 5-7 min, depending on thickness, until it flakes and the centre reads 63 °C.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Meanwhile heat the oil in the frying pan and cook the onion and garlic over medium heat for 6-8 min until soft. Stir in the olives and oregano and cook 2 min.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Break the salmon into bite-sized flakes and fold it into the onions; keep warm.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: Boil the fresh linguine in 2 litres salted water for 1-2 min and drain.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Toss the pasta gently with the salmon mixture so the flakes stay whole, and finish with black pepper. Olives and oregano bring the salty, herby notes a tomato sauce usually provides.

tips: Flake the salmon into large pieces and fold gently so it stays moist.
Dried oregano works; use half the amount.
A squeeze of lemon at the end brightens the fish.
storage: Best eaten straight away. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day, reheating gently until piping hot (74 °C).
